reason: The cited lines show a search tool that builds query parameters, obtains a client, and formats returned search results from an index covering GitHub issues, PRs, READMEs, and documentation. They do not show arbitrary host code execution, access to non-public/local/user-credentialed data, or delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-chosen destination. The returned search results are from external/public developer content such as GitHub issues, PRs, READMEs, and docs, which can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
